name: io.github.freema/mcp-design-system-extractor
description: MCP server for Storybook design systems — extract component HTML, styles and metadata.

environmentVariables.name: STORYBOOK_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Storybook instance (default: http://localhost:6006)

environmentVariables.name: NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to allow self-signed certificates on the Storybook host

environmentVariables.name: DEBUG
environmentVariables.description: Set to true for verbose logging on stderr
